tutorial.move.text: The platform runs west, under the departures board. {action}.
tutorial.move.note: First prompt after the cold open hands control back. Names the direction and the landmark, not the key: {action} is resolved per input family (spec 86.4).

tutorial.move.strong.text: Still west. The clinic bay is at the far end. {action}.

tutorial.move.hint.text: Ivo is in the west bay. Everything else on this platform can wait.

tutorial.look.text: Look along the platform. Half the canopy came down. {action}.

tutorial.look.strong.text: Turn her head, not her feet. {action}.
tutorial.look.strong.note: "Her" is Mara Venn. Mission and tutorial copy stay third-person limited, matching content/missions/prologue.json.

tutorial.look.hint.text: Surveying is looking twice at what nobody reported.

tutorial.interact.note: Fires against three different objects in the depot — the clinic bay door, the Feeder Three meter and the contractor crate — so the base line must not name any one of them.

tutorial.interact.strong.text: Stand square to it. The glass only reads from the front. {action}.

tutorial.interact.hint.text: Closer, and square on. Feeder Three sits at head height beside the bay door.

tutorial.dialogueChoice.text: Someone is waiting on an answer. {action}.
tutorial.dialogueChoice.note: Covers Ivo in person and Sera Holt over the radio. Do not name a speaker.

tutorial.dialogueChoice.strong.text: Pick a line. The careful answer is still an answer. {action}.

tutorial.ladderClimb.text: Service ladder, bolted to the lift housing. {action}.
tutorial.ladderClimb.note: The climb is an interact, not a jump. Ladder location matches the marker in content/missions/prologue.json: past the parked bus, east end.

tutorial.ladderClimb.strong.text: Both hands. The rungs are wet through. {action}.

tutorial.ladderClimb.hint.text: The upper platform has no stair. The ladder past the parked bus is the way up.

tutorial.vault.text: The walkway is out for two metres. {action}.
tutorial.vault.note: Escalates faster than the default (8s/18s) because an uncrossable ledge stops the campaign. Two metres and the intact handrail are the authored mission facts.

tutorial.vault.strong.text: Take the handrail and go over. It held through the surge. {action}.

tutorial.vault.hint.text: Two metres of deck missing. The handrail runs the whole span.

tutorial.sprint.text: Nine hours to the first surge band, less if the wind holds. {action}.
tutorial.sprint.note: The nine-hour window is Sera's line in content/dialogue/prologue_bridge.json. Sprint is optional, so the copy gives a reason rather than an instruction.

tutorial.objectiveJournal.text: Readings belong in the log, not in her memory. {action}.

tutorial.autosave.text: Checkpoint written. TIDELOCK saves at gates, ladders and handovers.
tutorial.autosave.note: The one tutorial with no action to perform — it explains something that already happened. Carries no {action} placeholder, because tutorialIllustratedAction() returns undefined for an elapsed completion.

tutorial.crouch.text: Clearance drops under the conduit run. {action}.

tutorial.crouch.strong.text: Lower. The tray brackets are at shoulder height. {action}.

tutorial.scan.text: Pulse the structure and read what comes back. {action}.
tutorial.scan.note: The tool is a maintenance pulse tool; the bound action is labelled Survey. Keep both words — the divergence is authored, not a mistake.

tutorial.scan.strong.text: Half charge. Spend it on what she cannot see from here. {action}.

tutorial.scan.hint.text: Maintenance units read a survey pulse as a work order. They will come and stand next to her.

tutorial.toolAction.text: The pulse tool works on the fitting, not on the air. {action}.

tutorial.toolAction.strong.text: Seat it against the housing first. {action}.

tutorial.evidencePickup.note: The 37-minute gap is never named in prologue copy. This line only teaches that records can be picked up.

tutorial.machineDetection.text: A maintenance frame has her on its map. It is working from one three days old.
tutorial.machineDetection.note: Completion is a world flag, not an action, so there is no {action} placeholder. Machines are malfunctioning municipal equipment, never antagonists.

tutorial.machineDetection.strong.text: Break the sight line. It stops looking before it decides anything.

tutorial.machineDetection.hint.text: Standing water and a corner both break a sight line. Arguing with it does not.

tutorial.deepWater.text: Above the knee the water moves faster than it looks. Find the kerb line.

tutorial.deepWater.strong.text: Stay on the kerb. The gallery floor drops away without marking.

tutorial.recoverFromDamage.text: She is hurt. Out of the water, get still, and let it settle.

tutorial.recoverFromDamage.strong.text: Out of the water first. Nothing improves standing in it.

action.scan.note: Fires the maintenance pulse tool. Kept short because it appears in the bindings list and on a touch button.

ui.prompt.keyboard.note: Desktop prompt composition, e.g. "Interact — E". The binding is resolved from the live keymap, never authored here.

ui.prompt.gamepad.note: Binding is the active pad's glyph name. Separate from the keyboard id so a locale can punctuate the two differently.

ui.prompt.touch.note: Touch never names a control: the on-screen button is highlighted instead (spec 86.4).
